variants.text: The writing under the glass has ends and the ends are down the stair. Reading it wants the cutters' rule — and the heat off the treads wants something that has already been through a fire and come out.
Nine hundred years and it is still too hot to put a hand flat on. Going down dressed for the Reach is going down dressed for somewhere cooler than this.
Cut, then poured over. Somebody made a way in and somebody else made very sure it stayed the only one.
